variants.headline: Grant programme passes over needy districts
variants.body: A government grant programme has passed over districts that needed it. Give {target} a fair hearing; outrage alone should not be allowed to write the whole verdict.

variants.headline: Need goes unanswered in grant allocation
variants.body: Districts in need were passed over by a government grant programme. Give {target} a fair hearing; outrage alone should not be allowed to write the whole verdict.

variants.headline: Government grants miss the districts in need
variants.body: A government grant allocation has overlooked the districts that needed support. Give {target} a fair hearing; outrage alone should not be allowed to write the whole verdict.
